ColdwellBankerHomes.com

Backing to a reserve and set on one of the neighborhood’s largest lots, this home offers wooded seclusion and resort-style living. Tucked behind a gated, courtyard-style entry, it welcomes you with a great layout. Head inside to a private study and a spacious formal dining room. The kitchen opens to the family room and features soft blue/gray cabinets, a stunning granite countertop, and a glass-tile accent backsplash. Enjoy the stainless 5-burner gas/convection range, plus newer hardware and lighting. Abundant windows brighten the breakfast and family rooms and frame peaceful views of the serene pool/spa oasis. The split plan includes a primary suite with patio access, a sitting nook, and a luxurious en-suite with seamless shower, soaking tub, and a large walk-in closet. Two secondary bedrooms include one with French doors to an atrium retreat, and these share a hall bath.  A covered patio overlooks the pool and spa, with winding flagstone paths and a fire pit area—your private getaway!
